title: Meta launches Muse Glimmer, an open-weight model that can run on a laptop
excerpt: The social media giant plans to release an open-weight version of Muse Spark, its most powerful AI model, soon, Mark Zuckerberg said on Monday.
content_html:
Mark Zuckerberg is launching a new AI model and a vision for a more open form of superintelligence.

The social media giant unveiled Muse Glimmer on Monday and said it is an open-weight, agentic model small enough to run on a Mac or PC. Open-weight means users can download and customize the model to run it locally instead of in the cloud.

Meta also plans to release an open-weight version of Muse Spark, its most powerful AI model, soon, Zuckerberg added.

Meta said it trained Glimmer on Muse Spark using a process known as distillation, where a smaller model learns from a larger "teacher" model.

Meta said that Glimmer, the latest model rolled out by the company's Superintelligence division led by former Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang, can perform complex reasoning and handle a broad range of agentic tasks while running on a consumer device with a single graphics card.

Glimmer can break a task, such as coding or admin work, into steps. Meta said it "performs strongly for its size class" on several benchmarks for large language models.

'Filled with doom'

The Meta CEO also published a 6,500-word essay making a positive case for superintelligent AI.

In the essay, titled "The Future Is for Everyone," Zuckerberg wrote that it was "surprising" that the discourse from so many of the people developing AI was so "filled with doom."

Zuckerberg said it would be wrong to restrict access to superintelligent AI to a handful of individuals or companies on safety grounds.

"Some argue that superintelligence itself or a small set of experts who control it should decide what is best for humanity. We disagree," Zuckerberg wrote.

Open vs closed

Meta's model launch comes as the tech industry is embroiled in a debate over open-weight AI.

Last month, nearly every major AI lab — including Meta — signed a public letter advocating for open-weight models, after the US government suggested it could sanction Chinese open models that were found to have distilled AI models built by their US rivals.

"Foreign labs currently hold several advantages here since American labs have to comply with many additional restrictions on training data," Zuckerberg wrote in his Monday essay. "US policy must reduce this additional friction if we want American open source models to lead over time."

While Meta has traditionally championed open-sourcing models, not all of the Llama series of open-weight models it first launched in 2023 impressed developers.

Meta took a different approach with Muse Spark, released earlier this year, which was developed under Wang and launched as a closed model. Although the latest version still trails the strongest models from Anthropic and OpenAI overall, it is competitive on several benchmarks.

The decision to launch Glimmer as an open-weight model under a permissive license echoes the strategy of China AI labs, such as Moonshot and DeepSeek, which are launching open models that offer developers a cheaper alternative to their US counterparts.

"Now that Meta Superintelligence Labs are up and running, we will resume releasing some open source models soon," Zuckerberg wrote in Monday's blog.

content_html_zh:
马克·扎克伯格正在推出一种新的人工智能模型，以及一种更开放的超级智能形式的愿景。

这家社交媒体巨头周一推出了 Muse Glimmer，并表示这是一个开放重量的代理模型，足够小，可以在 Mac 或 PC 上运行。 开放权重意味着用户可以下载并自定义模型以在本地而不是在云端运行。

扎克伯格补充说，Meta 还计划很快发布其最强大的人工智能模型 Muse Spark 的开放重量版本。

Meta 表示，它使用一种称为蒸馏的过程在 Muse Spark 上训练 Glimmer，即较小的模型向较大的“教师”模型学习。

Meta 表示，Glimmer 是由前 Scale AI 首席执行官 Alexandr Wang 领导的公司超级智能部门推出的最新模型，可以在具有单个显卡的消费设备上运行时执行复杂的推理并处理广泛的代理任务。

Glimmer 可以将任务（例如编码或管理工作）分解为多个步骤。 Meta 表示，它在大型语言模型的多个基准测试中“在其规模类别中表现强劲”。

“充满厄运”

Meta 首席执行官还发表了一篇 6,500 字的文章，为超级智能人工智能提供了积极的案例。

扎克伯格在题为《未来属于每个人》的文章中写道，这么多人工智能开发者的言论如此“充满厄运”，这令人“惊讶”。

扎克伯格表示，出于安全考虑，限制少数个人或公司使用超级人工智能是错误的。

“一些人认为，超级智能本身或控制它的一小群专家应该决定什么对人类最有利。 我们不同意，”扎克伯格写道。

开放式与封闭式

Meta 模型的推出正值科技行业陷入关于开放权重人工智能的争论之际。

上个月，几乎所有主要人工智能实验室（包括 Meta）都签署了一封公开信，倡导开放权重模型，此前美国政府表示可以制裁那些被发现提炼了美国竞争对手构建的人工智能模型的中国开放模型。

扎克伯格在周一的文章中写道：“外国实验室目前在这方面拥有多项优势，因为美国实验室必须遵守对训练数据的许多额外限制。” “如果我们希望美国的开源模式长期处于领先地位，美国政策就必须减少这种额外的摩擦。”

虽然 Meta 历来支持开源模型，但并非所有 2023 年首次推出的 Llama 系列开放权重模型都给开发者留下了深刻的印象。

Meta 在今年早些时候发布的 Muse Spark 中采取了不同的方法，它是在 Wang 的领导下开发的，并作为封闭模型推出。 尽管最新版本总体上仍落后于 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的最强模型，但它在多个基准测试中具有竞争力。

在许可下推出开放权重模型 Glimmer 的决定与 Moonshot 和 DeepSeek 等中国人工智能实验室的策略相呼应，这些实验室正在推出开放模型，为开发人员提供比美国同行更便宜的替代方案。

扎克伯格在周一的博客中写道：“既然元超级智能实验室已经启动并运行，我们将很快恢复发布一些开源模型。”
